### Pick a capability

Each capability below has its own quickstart with Python, JavaScript, and cURL samples.

## Endpoints at a glance

Every endpoint lives under `https://api.smallest.ai/waves/v1` and authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

| Capability | Model | Endpoint | How to select |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Text to speech (sync) | Lightning v3.1 Pro | `POST /waves/v1/tts` | `"model": "lightning_v3.1_pro"` or `"lightning_v3.1_pro_10_26"` (preview; `en`, `es`, `hi`) in the body |
| Text to speech (streaming) | Lightning v3.1 Pro | `POST /waves/v1/tts/live` (SSE) or `WSS /waves/v1/tts/live` (WebSocket) | Same `model` body field |
| Speech to text (pre-recorded) | Pulse, Pulse Pro | `POST /waves/v1/stt/` | `?model=pulse` or `?model=pulse-pro` |
| Speech to text (realtime) | Pulse | `WSS /waves/v1/stt/live` | `?model=pulse` |
| Speech to speech | Hydra | `WSS /waves/v1/s2s` | `?model=hydra` |
| LLM | Electron | `POST /waves/v1/chat/completions` | `"model": "electron"` in the body |
| Voice cloning | Lightning v3.1 | `POST /waves/v1/voice-cloning` | Upload a sample, get a `voice_id` |

Read [Choosing a transport](https://docs.smallest.ai/models/text-to-speech/choosing-a-transport) to choose a transport, and [Compare models](https://docs.smallest.ai/model-cards/compare) to pick one.

## SDKs

[Python\\
\\
`pip install smallestai`. Typed clients for every endpoint, including the WebSocket streams.](https://github.com/smallest-inc/smallest-python-sdk) [Node.js\\
\\
The official Node.js client for the Smallest AI API.](https://github.com/smallest-inc/smallest-node-sdk)

Using an agent framework? [LiveKit](https://docs.smallest.ai/integrations/agent-framework/live-kit), [Pipecat](https://docs.smallest.ai/integrations/agent-framework/pipecat), and the [Vercel AI SDK](https://docs.smallest.ai/integrations/sdks-libraries/vercel-ai-sdk) have first party plugins. ## Limits, errors, and regions

- [Concurrency and Limits](https://docs.smallest.ai/api-reference/concurrency-and-limits) covers per plan concurrency and rate limits.
- [Error reference](https://docs.smallest.ai/models/troubleshooting/error-reference) lists every status code the model endpoints return.
- East Asian streaming languages on Pulse are served from the US region at `wss://api.us.smallest.ai`. See the [Pulse model card](https://docs.smallest.ai/model-cards/speech-to-text/pulse).
